items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 11:1
items.html: Eden is the secret of Hochma, and Gan [garden] is a name of Malchut. And since the whole of Atzilut is the discernment of Hochma, the Malchut of Atzilut is therefore called Gan Eden, meaning the garden of Hochma. (p. 670, Item 76)
